shared.caveats:
All coverage figures refer to fixed line broadband only.

Some of this data has been aggregated and may show differences to other published figures.

Gigabit capable broadband.label: Gigabit capable broadband
Gigabit capable broadband.subtitle: Percentage of premises that have coverage from a gigabit-capable service (download speeds of at least 1,000 Mbps or more)
Gigabit capable broadband.longDescription: This indicator shows the percentage of premises that have coverage from a gigabit-capable service (download speeds of 1,000 Mbps or more), in the UK, as of January 2026.

Premises below 30Mbps.label: Premises below 30Mbps
Premises below 30Mbps.subtitle: Percentage of premises that do not have access to services above 30 Mbps
Premises below 30Mbps.longDescription: This dataset shows the percentage of premises that do not have access to services above 30 Mbps, UK, as of January 2026.

Superfast broadband.label: Superfast broadband
Superfast broadband.subtitle: Percentage of premises with access to a superfast broadband service (download speed of at least 30 Mbit/s)
Superfast broadband.longDescription: This indicator shows the percentage of premises with access to a superfast broadband service (download speed of at least 30 Mbit/s), in the UK, as of January 2026.

Ultrafast broadband.label: Ultrafast broadband
Ultrafast broadband.subtitle: Percentage of premises with access to a ultrafast broadband service (download speed of at least 300 Mbit/s)
Ultrafast broadband.longDescription: This indicator shows the percentage of premises with access to a ultrafast broadband service (download speed of at least 300 Mbit/s), in the UK, as of January 2026.

Premises with access to full fibre.label: Premises with access to full fibre
Premises with access to full fibre.subtitle: Percentage of premises that have coverage from a full-fibre service
Premises with access to full fibre.longDescription: This indicator shows the percentage of premises that have coverage from a full-fibre service, in the UK, as of January 2026.
